tools.name: check_bet
tools.description: Grade a sports bet against NegativeEV's game simulations. Input the bet as plain text (teams/players, market, line, odds). Returns each leg's simulated probability vs the implied odds and the resulting edge, or a status explaining why the bet can't be graded (no_slate, unsupported_market, unsupporte

tools.name: get_slate
tools.description: Whether there is a checkable slate right now (at least one simulated, not-yet-started game) in each live sport: MLB, WNBA, and ATP. Pass `sport` to ask about one; omit it for all of them. Free — spends no check.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: How many bet checks the caller has left and when the next one frees up — the daily allowance for anonymous callers, the hourly pace window for accounts. Free — spends no check.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_bet" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
